title: Gemma joins anonymous text generation
summary:
A quiet week brought another anonymous text model, less database contention around authentication, and a more accurate community-project listing.

`gemma-roblox`, backed by Gemma 2 9B IT Fast, was added for anonymous text generation with tool support and up to 1,024 output tokens.

Per-user metric writes were disabled at several call sites and an API-token lookup index was added to address contention affecting authentication requests. Text-generation success and error analytics moved from the text server to the cache worker.

The community-project listing now credits @CiaranMcAleer and links to Mimir AIP’s GitHub repository.
